en.t: For an instant, Ryohei stood frozen.

units.source_text: 天色逐渐昏暗，虽然说去年底黄昏的时候，自己曾和母亲一道儿赶路去过岩村，

en.t: The sky was gradually growing dark, and although at dusk late last year he had once walked the road to Iwamura with his mother,

units.source_text: 但是今天的路途差不多有去年三四倍，况且如今自己必须一个人走回家去，

en.t: today's distance was nearly three or four times as far, and on top of that he now had to walk home alone,

units.source_text: ——良平一下子意识到事情的严重性了。

en.t: Ryohei suddenly realized how serious the situation was.

units.source_text: 他就快哭出来了，但是哭有什么用呢？

en.t: He was on the verge of tears, but what good would crying do?

units.source_text: 良平知道现在还不是哭的时候。

en.t: Ryohei knew that now was not the time to cry.

units.source_text: 他别别扭扭的对这两个年轻的工人鞠躬告辞之后，就玩命般顺着轨道往回跑。

en.t: After awkwardly bowing farewell to the two young workers, he ran back along the tracks as if his life depended on it.
